sell_to_cap.text: At p={p}, the expected loss of staying exceeds the marginal exit cost up to the 45.00% capacity limit (cost 0.491% of value sold, x10.63 per unit of equity); the remaining 55.00% stays exposed to underlying / issuer risk.
